text:
TAQARIB AL-YOM AL-AAMM
Tatmou al-taqat al-falakyyah al-yawm bi-quwwah fi burjiq al-mifdal, ya Aqrab, makhliyyatan iyyaka nujman sate'an fi sama' al-tahawwulat al-ijabiyyah. Tashkur al-yawm halatan min al-safaa al-zehni al-aameq wa al-qowrah al-dakhiliyyah allati tumkinuka min tajawwuz ayyi su'ubah sabiqah bi-hikmah wa thibah. Innahu yawm munaseb jiddan li-tarik al-madi wa fatahn safdah jadidah maliah bil-amal wa al-tafao-ul al-haqiqi. Ruhuka al-shahmah tatasallaf al-da'm al-kawni li-tuhaqqiq taqadduaman malhoosan fi kaffeat shuo-un hayatika.

AL-ISHQ WA AL-ALAQAT
Li-al-arabiya al-murtabitun, al-yawm yahmilu ma'ahu thawrah min al-mashaeer al-dafeeah al-lati tu'zeez al-tafahum wa al-qorb bayna al-sharikayn, watakoon al-hiwariat akthar suhoorah wa omqan. Amma li-al-uzzaab, fa-al-falak yanba-u bi-imkaniyyat liqa' qadari aw ta'arruf 'ala shakhs yajlibu ila qalbika al-bahjah wa yuharrik mashaerak bi-tariqah mamiyyah. Da' al-tardaad yanfared wa unthur ila al-mustaqbal bi-qalb maftouh wa rooh mutafa-illah.

AL-AMAL WA AL-TAWTHIQ
Ala al-mustawa al-mihni, tastati' al-yawm an tathbit kafa'atak al-faridah wa an tulfit anzara al-mas'oolin bi-ijad halol ibda'iyyah lil-masa'il al-mo'aqqadah. Innahu waqt mithali li-taqdeem mashroo'at jadidah aw ibda' fi khutuwat mustaqbaliyyah tuazzizu makanataka al-mihnaiyyah. La tata'arram min i'lam sawtak aw taqdeem afkarika bi-thiqqah, fa-al-furas al-thahabiyyah tatawajahu nahwaka bi-quwwah.

AL-MAL WA AL-BARAKAH
Al-wad' al-mali yashhadu istiqraral malhoosan ma imkaniyyat husool 'ala mukafa'ah ghair mutawaqqah aw arbah maliyyah natifah 'an juhud sabiqah. Hunaka forsah li-tahtheem isttirah maliyyah thakiyyah aw istithmar mustaqbali ya'ud 'alayka bi-al-khair al-wafir. Unsur ila mushtariyatika bi-wa'yi wa la todri' amwalan fi ashya' ghair dharuriyyah, fa-al-tanzim al-mali sawfa yumkinuka min taqdeem amnan akbar.

AL-SIHHah WA AL-TAQA
Hayatuka al-badaniyyah wa al-nafisiyyah tatamatta' bi-taqah ijabiyyah kabirah tusaa'iduka 'ala al-injaz bi-nashaat wa hayawiyyah. Untashar al-yawm bi-imkaniyyat momtazah li-morasahat al-riyadah aw al-mashy fi al-tabia'ah li-tafriq al-taqah al-salbah. Unsur 'ala shurb al-ma' bi-kammiyyat kafiyah wa al-ihasool 'ala qist kaafin min al-nawm li-tahfeez al-zehn wa istimrar al-hafiwah al-isbitan.

AL-ITTIWASAL WA AL-BI'AH
Al-wasat al-muhit bika min a'ila wa asdiqa' yumtilu bi-al-da'm al-sadiq wa al-mahabba al-khalisah al-lati tumanuka al-da'm al-nafsi. Innahu waqt ra'i li-qad' waqt amti' ma' al-muharribin al-muqarrabin aw tahqeeq ittisalat ijtima'iyyah jadidah tufeeduq al-kthir. Sawt al-hikmah allati tumallukahu sawfa yaj'aluka marja'an li-man hawlaka fi hal al-mushkilat aw talab al-naseeha.

NARIHah AL-YOM
Thaqa bi-hadisika al-dakhili fa-huwa al-dalil al-amtar li-takhazz al-qirar al-sahih fi al-waqt al-munasib; la tardad fi tariki al-khawf wahdha al-tamassok bi-al-amal.

TAFASIL AL-YOM
Al-raqm al-hazeez: 8
Al-lawn al-hazeez: Al-ahmar al-qani
Al-burj al-mutawafeq: Al-sartan
